description: This file defines the main page component for task management in a React application. It includes state management, data fetching from APIs, and rendering of task list, forms, and controls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches tasks from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new task via API and updates task list.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing task via API and updates task list.

methods.name: onToggle
methods.description: Toggles completion status of a task via API and updates task list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task via API and updates task list.
